scope: Fixes the H13D login loop where credentials succeeded but the user returned to Login after the browser reload
Uses CookieManager only to write the application-domain opaque marker and removes all CookieManager read-back confirmation
Persists the reload phase before CookieManager.set so component-triggered Streamlit reruns continue safely
Forces one full parent-browser reload after the marker commit so Streamlit context receives the cookie on the initial request
Retains the H13C durable Supabase session table, hashed marker, token refresh, role validation and logout revocation
excluded: No Flutter or Admin Lite code change
No assessment, report, recommendation, schedule or member-data contract change
No password, access token or refresh token stored in browser cookies, URLs or local storage
